descriptions.d20d_text_width_8018c8bc: Width of a laid-out text line: sum the glyph values of every 16-bit glyph reference in the vector at +180/+184 (high byte selects a track handle in slot 7 of the font node at +168, low byte the glyph), starting from the float at 0x803a7e2c, multiply by the text size at +36 and divide by the weight of the first track's first glyph. Field meanings are inferred.
